late_fusion_evaluation.preserves_instrument_representations: Yes. Individual branches extract features independently before combining them.
late_fusion_evaluation.heterogeneous_solar_appropriateness: Yes. Decouples physical processes (impulsive vs thermal phases) and combines them at a semantic level.
late_fusion_evaluation.information_discarding: Yes. Time-series sequences are compressed via attention pooling before cross-attention. This drops patch-wise temporal resolutions.
late_fusion_evaluation.temporal_relationships_preserved: Yes. Chronological patch embedding and sinusoidal PositionalEncoding preserve ordering.
late_fusion_evaluation.physical_information_lost: Yes. Downsampling SoLEXS/HEL1OS from 5s to 1m cadences discards sub-minute solar flare triggers and fast spikes.
late_fusion_evaluation.solar_physics_reflection: Yes. Accommodates the temporal delay between high-energy hard X-ray impulsive phases (HEL1OS) and soft X-ray thermal phases (SoLEXS/GOES).

early_fusion.scientific_advantages: Models cross-feature interactions starting at the input layer.
early_fusion.deployment_disadvantages: Extremely fragile. Gaps in one satellite stream cause NaN propagation across all features.

cross_attention_fusion.scientific_advantages: Enables baseline (GOES) representations to be dynamically query-modulated by impulsive diagnostics (HEL1OS).

hierarchical_fusion.scientific_advantages: Preserves sub-minute 5s cadence observations from Aditya-L1 without downsampling.
hierarchical_fusion.deployment_disadvantages: High memory consumption, high data loading latency.

temporal_fusion_transformer.scientific_advantages: Leverages Variable Selection Networks to dynamically weigh features based on solar cycles.
temporal_fusion_transformer.deployment_disadvantages: High parameter count, high deployment latency.
